integrity: The proof is analytical for all n>=3. check.py is standalone finite corroboration, not an infinite certificate. No independent expert audit or other certification is claimed.
limitations: The result covers the two alternating Coxeter elements in the ordinary one-line coordinate realization, not arbitrary Coxeter elements or the inverse-permutation coordinate realization. Historical priority has not been independently established.
title: A two-unit orientation gap in Euclidean diameters of zigzag Bruhat interval polytopes
